scope: Book parent only. Prose is a child system; Document rendering/conversion and System Master app presentation remain separately owned; human/author/publication evidence is never synthesized.

matrix.capability: Canonical Book/project state, exact state identity and parent-only mutation authority
matrix.finding: The qualified state model validates Book project identity, active pointers, manuscript authority, research/decision/proposal/export collections, exact state version/digest CAS and bounded actor authority.

matrix.capability: Representation of governing brief, canon manifest, story bible, book plan and manuscript manifest in canonical parent state
matrix.finding: These object classes and active references are part of validated parent state. This classification is representation/selection only and does not imply that creation/versioning/admission of new instances is implemented.

matrix.capability: Create, version and canonically admit new governing brief, canon manifest, story bible, book plan and manuscript objects
matrix.finding: The qualified canonical mutation operation set can SET_ACTIVE_* for existing brief/canon/story-bible/book-plan/manuscript objects and can register research links, author decisions, integration proposal refs and export releases, but it exposes no REGISTER/CREATE/VERSION operation for new brief, canon, story-bible, book-plan or manuscript objects. Runtime V2 appends an integration-proposal reference only; it does not materialize the proposed content object into canonical parent state.
matrix.why_material: Without this parent-owned admission layer, the governance spine can safely reason about and transition already-existing long-form content state but does not itself complete the persistent authoring pipeline that creates and promotes new Book content objects.

matrix.capability: Persistent chapter/scene object creation, ordering, versioning and parent admission
matrix.finding: The canonical project hierarchy defines CHAPTER and SCENE as Book domain levels, and Book Intelligence assigns meso-level chapter/scene goals and transitions to the parent architecture, but the qualified canonical state mutation surface does not expose chapter/scene registration or version/promotion operations. Phase 2 must decide whether this is satisfied inside the same canonical content-object admission successor rather than creating a second engine.

matrix.capability: Versioned Book service interface across Prose, Book Evaluation, Research/Evidence and Document/Export providers
matrix.finding: Registry V2 is separately qualified and preserves provider non-authority, exact identities and output/evidence classes.

matrix.capability: Parent intake, deduplication, proposal snapshots, bounded admission state and non-success preservation
matrix.finding: Runtime V2 provides exact request/response binding, source/artifact/provenance currentness, proposal state, author-handoff and parent-only admission discipline. It registers proposal refs, not canonical content-object materialization.

matrix.capability: Research/evidence provider intake, freshness/conflict/rights-aware preservation and parent evidence linkage
matrix.finding: The Book parent can consume bounded research/evidence responses and preserve evidence identity/currentness. Acquisition/search execution itself remains provider-owned rather than a Book research crawler.

matrix.capability: Book lifecycle transitions, editorial-stage gates, stale-evidence blocking and author-required boundaries
matrix.finding: Lifecycle v1 remains the sole qualified lifecycle transition authority.

matrix.capability: Preserve lifecycle semantics and persistent lifecycle history across later sealed parent successors
matrix.finding: The compatibility/rebind layer preserves Lifecycle v1 policy and history while rebinding exact parent identity after authorized non-lifecycle successors.

matrix.capability: Immutable Book state/version history, exact successor recording, rollback/restore-as-new-successor and concurrency protection
matrix.finding: Separately A-01 qualified. The shared work-obligation registry still marking this ACTIVE is stale control metadata and must be reconciled without reopening the work.

matrix.capability: Durable pending author decisions, exact human resolution binding, stale decision protection and immutable receipts
matrix.finding: Machine handling is qualified. The runtime does not and must not fabricate the human choice itself.

matrix.capability: Real author consent, revision direction, finalization approval and publication authorization
matrix.finding: Machine gates are qualified, but all qualification author evidence is synthetic. Real author choice remains a human input and is intentionally not machine-completable.

matrix.capability: Parent-owned export-freeze admission after exact format/proof/currentness/rights/privacy evidence
matrix.finding: Book freeze policy is qualified and remains distinct from publication authorization.

matrix.capability: DOCX/PDF/EPUB rendering, conversion, layout, generic format/accessibility validation and rendered proof mechanics
matrix.finding: Book owns domain/export acceptance policy and release authority boundaries; reusable rendering/conversion/proof implementation belongs to Document System or the registered Document/Export provider. No second Book renderer is required.

matrix.capability: W3C PROV and optional C2PA external provenance projection
matrix.finding: The projection architecture and privacy/rights/currentness laws are defined; Book does not own a duplicate credential embedding/signing engine. Concrete credential implementation is provider/deployment dependent.

matrix.capability: Macro/meso/micro Book Intelligence orchestration across structure, canon, chapter/scene goals, prose intent and evidence
matrix.finding: The orchestration ownership model is defined, but no separately qualified Book Intelligence orchestrator was identified in the current executable Book directory. Phase 2 must determine whether this should be implemented as the canonical content-object admission/orchestration successor or remains satisfied by existing parent services.

matrix.capability: Literary prose analysis, revision, line/stylistic refinement and prose-specific qualification
matrix.finding: PROSE is a child of BOOK with its own control path. Book may consume Prose evidence/proposals but must not absorb or duplicate the Prose engine.

matrix.capability: Book evaluation/qualification capability currently allocated under Prose
matrix.finding: Historical Book Evaluator work and evidence are preserved but current ownership is under SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK/PROSE/BOOK_EVALUATOR. Book parent consumes the service seam only.

matrix.capability: Machine transition from frozen export toward published/delivered state only after required authority evidence
matrix.finding: The machine boundary is qualified; technical export success cannot imply publication authorization.

matrix.capability: Real publication authorization, distributor submission/delivery and external release acceptance
matrix.finding: Real publication requires explicit human/author authority and may depend on external distributor/platform rules. Synthetic qualification evidence cannot satisfy it.

matrix.capability: iPhone Book deck, chat-driven Book controls, author-decision presentation and durable artifact presentation
matrix.finding: Book supplies semantic state/operations and decision requirements. Native application presentation, identity/session UX and cross-tool artifact surfaces belong to System Master Core/app presentation rather than a second Book UI runtime.

matrix.capability: Synthetic composition of canonical state, provider intake, lifecycle, versioning, author decisions, export freeze and publication boundary
matrix.finding: Hosted and authoritative A-01 both pass 48/48. Scope is synthetic composition only and does not erase the content-object admission gap or prove production/human authority.

matrix.capability: Production deployment, persistence backend, operational observability and live release readiness for Book inside System Master
matrix.finding: The Book machine qualifications prove deterministic domain behavior, not product-wide deployment/operations. Production host, persistence integration, observability and app release are System Master/Core/platform concerns unless a later census finding proves a Book-specific missing adapter.

phase_001_conclusions.qualified_spine: The Book governance/admission/lifecycle/version/author/export spine is materially executable and exact-SHA qualified through synthetic E2E composition.
phase_001_conclusions.first_proven_book_owned_machine_gap: Book has no qualified parent operation that creates/versions/admits new long-form content objects (governing brief, canon manifest, story bible, book plan, manuscript; chapter/scene granularity also lacks an explicit qualified admission path).
do_not_misclassify_as_gap: Prose literary refinement: child Prose ownership
Book Evaluator: child Prose capability ownership
Native iPhone presentation: System Master/Core ownership
Real author decisions and publication authorization: human authority
phase_001_conclusions.book_intelligence_question: Phase 2 must decide whether Book Intelligence needs a separately executable orchestrator or whether its necessary machine behavior should be satisfied by the same canonical content-object admission layer plus existing qualified services.
stale_governance_to_reconcile: Shared WORK-OBLIGATION-REGISTRY-001 still marks BOOK-SYSTEM-VERSION-AND-ROLLBACK-001 active even though its exact subject is authoritative A-01 PASS.
Book Second Shift active routing predates State-023 and must be rebound to census work only if useful unattended work remains.

phase_002_objective: Forensically define the smallest successor contract for the proven Book-owned content-object admission/versioning gap, determine whether chapter/scene and Book Intelligence orchestration belong inside that same boundary, reconcile stale shared Book obligation/completion metadata, and update Second Shift to the resulting exact current objective.
